description: An HTML file implementing a web-based database viewer interface, including styles and client-side scripts for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entry to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders an HTML table based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a cell, handling long text, nulls, and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
